name: Dustin's Arcade: Games & Prizes
description: Dustin's Arcade games and prizes: 16 realistic ticket redemption machines (Alley Roller, Hoop Frenzy, Big Wheel, Bonus Drum, Plinko Drop, High Striker, Air Hockey, Lucky Locker and more), five themed pinball tables with their own playfields, a prize counter and prize wall where tickets buy real items, plus video arcade cabinets.
